mods.name: Smart Track
mods.author: maximevincentclaudeai
mods.summary: Touch the Tag List tab: tracks matching the playing track's BPM, key and playlists, plus a set name.
mods.description:
Touching the Tag List tab opens an overlay of tracks from your USB library that fit the playing track: BPM within a range (pitch included), key within +/-1 on the Camelot wheel, and the playlists you choose to watch (leave ALL out). The browse knob scrolls it. It proposes a set name such as House 124 BPM 8A.

Each criterion can be switched off in Mod Menu > Smart Track and your choices are kept on the USB. First use: Calibrate Tag List tab, then touch the tab once. The mod only reads the library and deck state; no files, no network, no patches.
